name: real-estate-and-property
description: Use this skill when an individual or company buys, lets or sells residential property in the United Kingdom. It covers Stamp Duty Land Tax (England and Northern Ireland) in depth, with the slice method, the 5% higher rates for additional dwellings, the 2% non-resident surcharge, first-time buyer relief up to GBP 500,000, the 17% rate for companies and the 14-day return; the Scottish LBTT bands, 8% Additional Dwelling Supplement and Welsh LTT tables; a short 2026/27 routine for individual landlords (repairs against improvements, replacement of domestic items, the finance-cost restriction at 20%, the GBP 1,000 property allowance, Rent-a-Room GBP 7,500, former furnished holiday lets, Making Tax Digital thresholds, property rates of 22%, 42% and 47% from 2027/28); and Capital Gains Tax on residential property at 18% or 24% with the 60-day return. Transactions and tax year 2026/27. Trigger on SDLT, stamp duty, LBTT, ADS, LTT, buy-to-let, second home surcharge, landlord tax, mortgage interes
